title: WordPress
subtitle: Every WordPress site you manage: updates, staging copies and a security check.
none: No WordPress site was found among your websites.
bulkConfirm: Update {count} sites now? Each site is updated in turn.
updateHelp: Updates run with plugins and themes switched off for the command, so a broken plugin cannot stop its own update. Take a staging copy first for a big update.
securityHelp: Checks core files against wordpress.org, plugin files, admin names, open registration, debug mode and file editing.
fixFailed: The fix could not be applied.
reinstallConfirm: Download WordPress core again over the current files? Content, plugins and themes are not touched.

core_files.issue: Some core files are changed or should not be there

admin_names.pass: No administrator has an easily guessed name
admin_names.issue: An administrator has an easily guessed name

debug.issue: Debug mode is on and can show errors to visitors

file_edit.pass: The theme and plugin file editor is off
file_edit.issue: Admins can edit PHP files from wp-admin

plugin_updates.pass: All plugins are up to date

stagingHelp: Pair this site with another of your sites as its staging copy. Copying replaces the other site's files and database (they go to the trash first) and rewrites the site address.
noFreeSite: Create another website to use as staging first
unlinkConfirm: Unpair these sites? Neither site is changed.
copyConfirm: Copy {from} over {to}? {to}'s current files and database go to the trash first.
deployConfirm: Deploy {from} over the live site {to}? The live files and database go to the trash first.

stage.testing: Updating and testing the staging copy…

safeHelp: Copy this site over its staging site, update the copy, and update this site only if the copy still loads without errors. Needs a linked staging site.
safeStarted: Safe update started. Follow it on the Staging tab.
